chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
There is no khums (or zakat) in young camels until a full year passes over them from the day they are born.

key_terms.الْحَوْلُ: the passing of a full year

ai.seo_question: When does the year begin for calculating zakat on young camels?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the nisab timing for young camels, establishing that the hawl (lunar year) for zakat begins from the day of birth rather than the date of acquisition, a nuance critical for precise agricultural taxation. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling is often discussed alongside the broader principles of zakat on livestock, emphasizing the Prophet's tradition as interpreted by the Imams to ensure fairness in religious dues.
